toll_scope.name: one_exchange
toll_scope.question: 换这一次要付多少
toll_scope.decision_use: INCREMENTAL: the only cost a 'act again?' decision moves
toll_scope.why: the exchange this desk already made is paid whether it acts again or not; an unwind pays the same exchange once more, and that total is a different number

recheck_rule: nothing to act on: no pair clears the toll of the exchange. After execution the only number that can bring the decision back is the toll of the exchange it would have to make: re-read this face on the next decision bar, and act again only if a pair's gap exceeds 0.16 pp (2 sides x 8 bp). Getting the book back where it came from pays that same exchange once more, so the whole manoeuvre is 0.32 pp (4 sides) -- that number answers 'did the discount pay for the trip', never 'may I act'.
caveats: the trigger is priced in pp of notional and compared against the toll of ONE exchange (0.16 pp, 2 sides) only; the whole manoeuvre (0.32 pp, 4 sides) is published next to it and is never the threshold. It does not price tracking difference, fee, size or FX-hedge policy between the two tickers
episode lengths are measured on the reconstructed gap, which inherits the single IOPV anchor of the gap face; censored episodes are reported, never scored as zero
a 'window always open' reading means the pair is structurally wide, not that the swap has to be repeated: the book only has to hold it once
